scope: Corrected SigLIP 2 comparison. Explicit lowercase of all input text before fast Gemma tokenization. V1 with capitalized class names is invalidated as a preprocessing defect. Same cub100 classes/images/230 attributes and native SigLIP visual features, five controls, two learning rates, three seeds. All v2 choices locked before v2 final evaluation; prior CLIP and defective v1 final results were inspected, so exploratory. Fixed temperature 20 shared by all variants preserves native class ranking. Not full AG-CLIP reproduction.
